_comment: The five Modal invocations of cloud/modal_runtime.py on 2026-11-06 (H200, app agenticrl-cuda-kernels). Order is chronological. Only the two full runs carry rollout metrics; the others are build/preflight evidence. Every path is relative to AgenticRL-CUDA-kernels/.

runs.notes: First image build failed: pip could not resolve cuda-toolkit[nvcc,nvvm,tileiras]>=13.3,<13.4 against torch's cuda-toolkit==13.0.3 runtime pin. Fixed by pinning the 13.3.x nvidia-cuda-* components directly in requirements-gpu.txt.

Preflight only (modal run cloud/modal_runtime.py). Image im-aBtUChfr0yrsAWxSpfC4WL built; all five runtime profiles ok: driver 610.57.04, nvcc 13.3, tileiras 13.3.36, torch 2.14.1+cu130, triton 3.8.0, tilelang 0.1.15, cuda-tile 1.8.0, nvidia-cutlass-dsl 4.8.1.

First full run (--tests). Triton, TileLang, cuTile and CuTe DSL honest fixtures passed with provenance 1.0 and every Torch-op hack failed provenance; the stock CUDA build failed because utils/compile.py forced -std=c++17 while Torch 2.14 requires C++20. GPU suite: Ran 30 tests, FAILED (failures=2), both from the failed CUDA rollout. The uploaded environment.json was a stale local CPU record (kept as environment-uploaded-stale-20261106T142830Z.json); the corrected record was reconstructed from require.stdout.

Preflight after the compile fix; Modal aborted the image build locally with 'modal-preflight-rebuild.log was modified during build process' because the log was being written inside the directory being uploaded. No GPU code ran. (Lesson: write Modal session logs outside the mounted folder or add them to the add_local_dir ignore list.)

Successful rerun (--tests) after the C++ standard fix. All five remote stages exited 0. Stock CUDA pipeline passed; record_kernel_names captured the device symbols for cuda, triton, tilelang, cutile and cutedsl, all classified agent with no unmatched authored names; GPU suite: Ran 30 tests in 380.509s, OK; scripts.validate: five honest fixtures verified at provenance 1.0 (reward 2, faster_than_eager), four Torch-op hacks verified at provenance 0.0 (reward -1), timeout/max_turns as expected, DAPO overlong reward 1.25.
